subject: Quick thought on Launderette's online menu and event bookings
body: Hi team at Launderette, I always enjoy stopping by your space in the Holly neighborhood for Chef Rene's globally inspired Southern dishes and weekend brunch. While looking over the site recently, I noticed that private event inquiries rely on a direct email address rather than an interactive form, and secondary pages could benefit from tighter search optimization. I went ahead and built a modern, single-page prototype for you that highlights your weekday happy hour right at the top and adds a streamlined private event inquiry form. You can check out the live preview here: https://nayom-biz-0x8644b44b02e40143-0x358a05fe0dd85bf-co8aqflc8.vercel.app. If you would like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I would be happy to send over the project files or chat for five minutes. No worries at all if you are happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Added a direct interactive inquiry form for private events
Highlighted happy hour specials prominently at the top of the homepage
